pr.title: Dashboards: Add possibility to lock multi value variables option list
pr.body:

**What is this feature?**

There are scenarios where we do not want the ability to add custom values to a variable values list. This PR adds a new setting in the dashboard to lock the options list.

The new option is found in the dashboard settings when editing a variable. Under `Selection Options` there is now a new flag (`Allow custom values`) which is true by default to maintain existing functionality. Unchecking this flag will no longer show arbitrary strings entered in the input as selectable options, thus locking the values list to only the values returned by the variable itself.

**Why do we need this feature?**

We have requests for this feature.

**Who is this feature for?**

Everyone

**Special notes for your reviewer:**

Adds the settings flag for Query, Custom, Datasource and AdHoc variables as these are the only variables that support multi values and also allow custom values to be entered.

Depends on https://github.com/grafana/scenes/pull/956
